items: 更新随包使用说明的文档链接，指向规范化后的项目与框架指南。
向 pretask 和 Agent 传递实际 Host 产品版本，独立保留 PI 协议、原生运行库与项目版本。
发现 PI v2 与 MXU/MFA/CFA/MaaPiCli 来源，保留独立任务、重复次数和分层选项。
验证本地运行库和 Python 输入，保存初始化后提交修订；来源同步不重放项目程序。
按真实框架任务结果进行有限失败子集续跑，保留成功任务和每次尝试。
关闭 Maa 自定义判断入口，保留旧资产；使用独占原生日志和 Agent 标准输出。
兼容 CFA 保存的关闭状态速通元数据，启用状态明确阻断。
使用最小查询权限读取游戏窗口的进程路径与启动时间，兼容禁止模块枚举的游戏进程。
遵循 MXU 保存的预任务开关和选项，并向外部 Agent 提供已验证的原生运行库路径。
兼容 MFA 保存但未启用的游戏启动路径，保留来源配置并阻断未支持的启动及断线重试动作。
发现并读取 MFA 旧式共享配置中的已登记实例，隔离实例字段并保留任务选择和顺序。
兼容 MFA 保存的窗口提示与 Agent 通道偏好，保持 Host 已核验的进程身份和独占会话。
适配 Host 0.17.2 与 Plugin API 2.2，完善面向用户的安装、配置和使用说明。

en-US.description: Run MaaFramework Project Interface projects with isolated workers, verified dependencies and independent task options.

items: Update bundled documentation links to the canonical project and framework guides.
Pass the actual Host product version to pretasks and Agents while keeping PI, native runtime and project versions independent.
Discovers PI v2 and MXU/MFA/CFA/MaaPiCli sources with independent occurrences, repeat counts and layered options.
Verifies local native/Python inputs and initializes saved revisions; passive source synchronization starts no project programs.
Retries the failed suffix within Host limits using native task results, retaining successful tasks and per-attempt evidence.
Disables Maa custom judgement while preserving existing assets; captures session-owned native logs and Agent standard output.
Accepts inactive speedrun metadata saved by CFA and explicitly rejects enabled speedrun behavior.
Reads window process paths and creation times with limited query access, supporting games that deny module enumeration.
Honors saved MXU pretask selection and options, and supplies the verified native library path to external Agents.
Accepts saved inactive MFA software paths without launching programs or enabling unsupported startup and reconnect actions.
Discovers registered MFA instances in shared configuration files while isolating instance fields and preserving task selection and order.
Accepts MFA saved window hints and Agent transport preferences while retaining Host-verified process identity and session ownership.
Targets Host 0.17.2 and Plugin API 2.2 with installation, configuration and usage documentation.
